question: The Rourkela Steel plant was set up in 1959 in collaboration with ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Germany**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Rourkela Steel Plant was set up in 1959 in the Sundargarh district of Odisha in collaboration with Germany.
 
• It was set up in collaboration with the **German company Krupp and Demag in 1955**.
 
• The plant has an annual production capacity of 4.5 million tonnes of hot metal and 4.2 million tonnes of crude steel.
 
• The Rourkela steel plant is one of the largest steel plants in India and is a major contributor to the economy of Odisha.
 
• The plant receives coal from Jharia (Jharkhand) and iron ore from Sundargarh and Kendujhar.
 
• The Hirakud Project supplies power for the electric furnaces and water is obtained from the Sankh and the Koel rivers.
